name: Black Alice
original_name: アリスフィーズ・フェイタルベルン
source:
A legendary warmongering Monster Lord that was struck down by Heinrich. She was said to wield incredibly high-powered magic and greedy ambitions. Right after she was defeated by Heinrich, she was saved by Ilias and taken under her umbrella...

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
